Checked into site   Took a little while for someone to meet me at the location to access unit   After access to roof checked the alarm history show as follow   A404 down emergency mode fire smoke   T074 space temperature thermistor failure   T617 outside dampers stuck or jammed     Noted that when unit would come up on line go though the purge and run for about a min cycle off then little bit of time it would start to run purge then show alarm of the dampers and thermistor failure then start to run in low cool and cycle off with temperature of 65 and 66     Called Ray Johnson and he stated there is either a bad thermistor or wiring issues with break down in wire or connections he is getting with Michael Lunsford

No heat. Found supply return and outdoor air sensors are not installed. Heat is locked out on, four consecutive limit trips. Without supply air sensor, unit won???t reduce from high fire, in a low air flow scenario, and the limit opens.
Recovered refrigerant in circuit B. Changed high pressure switch. Recharged unit and checked unit for proper operation.

Met for meeting with other contractors to go over list of issues. One issue was RTU-9 was over cooling. Got access to roof and found that unit was over cooling during reheat mode. Looked at temp sensor accuracy. Found that leaving air temp was always reading in high 70s. Searched for location of this sensor. Found staged gas thermistors with wires pulled loose from plugs. Corrected wires and found leaving air temp to read the air leaving the supply fan. Watched unit run and saw that it maintained temperature in the space, without overcooling.

Recovered approx 30 pounds of 410 A from circuit. Performed nitro leak check to ensure there were no other leaks. Repaired leak at suction line header. Performed another leak check and confirmed that leaks were repaired. Began evacuation of circuit.  Double checked vacuum to ensure system was still holding and then charged with 39.5 pounds of 410A. Monitored unit operation.

Found the blower motor contactor in the main electrical cabinet, with a stripped out terminal from the factory. I ordered a replacement from RCD, Also had a faulty fuse in the blower vfd bypass/vfd housing. It is mounted on a control transformer, that feeds 120volts. The fuse would occasionally read resistance, but would sometimes read open if it was moved or disturbed in housing. Ordered replacement, will return with parts.
UNIT NOT WORKING  REHEAT VALVE NOT CLOSING DOWN  REPLACE REHEAT VALVE

Arrive and check in with customer. Bring up lift to the 4 duct runs for office area. Check all isolation dampers for proper operation. Check RTUs 1and 4 vfds. Supply fans are running at 100 percent at 57 hz. Begin looking for static pick up tube. Will need to return.

Follow up from previous day. Talked with Doug Bare by phone in am. Loaded up cooling and took readings through out the day and reported to Doug. Went on partners and loaded the latest version software 10.2 and installed on RTU. Will follow up with Doug.  Met with Tom, Neil, Nick and discussed the operating conditions of RTU. We checked where the static pickup tunes were located. We also located the staged gas sensors in the ducts. We checked configurations on roof. Tom will make a report of the visit today. I will return with a staged gas board that was found defective on RTU #2.
rooftop unit not entering in heating mode. install new software after discussion with Bob Loomis.

Thermistor sensor inoperable. Wired temp probe into terminal board 5 and ran probe into return air duct. Checked schedule and set it up for 24 hr occupancy.  Alarm LED on, MO program running. Had to reload A series RTU profile. CCN comm ok, worked with controls contractor to verify communications and commands.

Return to troubleshoot control boards in RTU 11. Worked with Doug Bare and software engineers on verifying what is causing the unit to continually run after smoke shutdown is has occurred. Unable to determine in field at this time. Carrier engineering will get back with us with an answer. Return unit back to normal. Unit restarted and is operating.

While onsite for configurations changes, found unit with a ecb 1 Board not Communicating. Check board on unit and found the board with no lights showing on the board. Determined that board was bad on unit and informed customer that board would be ordered.    Went back to site after receiving part for rooftop. Replaced ECB on rooftop for customer and got economizer back operational. Tested economizer to make sure economizer was properly functioning on rooftop. Informed customer that economizer was operating correctly for rooftop.

Replaced defective ECB1 board on RTU-5. Checked operation. Straightened out other issues with Carrier RTUs. All 3 carrier units online and in service without alarms. Closed hatch, Checked out with customer.
Unit Not cooling.  Economizer board had failed.  Replaced the board.
unit not working  board not sending millivolt signal  replaced board

Rtu 1 has been randomly tripping drive on earth fault. Unit was running when I arrived. Someone had disabled compressor A1 saying fan only tripped when it would run. Enabled A1 compressor and waited on it to start. Unit stayed online and didn't trip. Placed call with tech support. Was told software for vfd needs to be upgraded but can disable earth fault in drive for now. Will return to disable setting on Monday    Shut down rtu 1. Disabled earth fault in supply fan vfd. Enabled compressor A1. Restarted unit.
Unit had alarm T701 for gas thermistor.Found bad connection on scb board.Repaired,no alarm now.Hrs 268,Str 483

Check in, haul tools to job site. Troubleshoot 2 RTUs for not cool enough air issues. Recorded all set points and temperatures. Compared and contrast with 2 proper working units. Made necessary adjustments. Data recordings to be sent off to engineers. Troubleshoot issue of space sensor not reading same temperature as set point. Calibrated and offset sensor to bring numbers in alignment.

Returned to site to make warranty staged gas thermistor repair to unit #4. Removed staged gas thermistor due to finding thermistor bad on start up and ran new wire/sensor with the help of Chad. Also reconfigured all the 48P units to enable CO2 sensors.  Drove to site. Assisted Levi with installation of me sensor. Programmed and configured co2 sensors on all units.
